files.vendor/cleanyourtv/tools/docker-build.ps:
$k = $env:HOST_KEY_DIR
$abs = if ([System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($k)) { "yes" } else { "no" }
$d = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $k -PathType Container) { "yes" } else { "no" }
Add-Content -LiteralPath $env:FAKE_BIN_LOG -Value "docker-build abs=$abs isdir=$d dir=$k"
$out = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "../launcher/app/build/outputs/apk/release"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out "app-release.apk") -Value ""
exit 0
